Thanks for your insight! So after some testing I've figured out that if we add `vim.o.termguicolors = true` it starts working properly. Not sure why it works that way, because `:echo &termguicolors → 1` after Neovim loads anyway. Also `Snacks.quickfile` can cause the same issue, but that's another story...

> Thanks for your insight! So after some testing I've figured out that if we add `vim.o.termguicolors = true` it starts working properly. Not sure why it works that way, because `:echo &termguicolors → 1` after Neovim loads anyway.

This looks like a "slow terminal" issue. Starting from Neovim=0.10 there is an automatic detection of 'termguicolors' value. By default it is `false` (i.e. "off"), but there is some terminal emulator magic behind the scenes during startup which "asks" terminal emulator whether it supports "gui colors" (i.e. 24-bit "regular" RGB colors). The response from terminal emulator can take some time, which is probably too much of a delay here. And as highlight groups don't define "not gui colors" attributes, it at first appears as no highlighting at all, although color scheme is probably applied.

Setting explicitly `vim.o.termguicolors = true` makes Neovim not ask terminal emulator for its supports and just sets it right away. This looks like a proper solution here.
